name: Nancy Quinn
occupation: Washakie County assessor (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Washakie County assessor (won the November 2022 general election; listed in the official staff directory)
background: Nancy Quinn is the Washakie County assessor, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. She won the November 2022 general election, and the official staff directory lists her in that office. Incoming assessor Bobby Swalstad takes office in January 2027.
